fields.name: date
fields.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Anchors the natal chart and the Vimshottari dasha sequence.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Birth time in 24-hour HH:MM:SS format. Precision matters for the natal positions the transit aspects are measured against.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: IANA name (e.g. "America/New_York", "Europe/London", "UTC"), decimal hours (e.g. -5 for EST, 1 for CET), or a fixed UTC offset (e.g. "-05:00", "+01:00"). Prefer the IANA name: it is resolved to the offset in force at the birth date and time, historical daylight-saving rules included, while a fixed offset or decimal is taken literally and will be wrong if it does not match the daylight-saving state at that moment. On a transition day a time in the repeated hour is read as its first occurrence and a time in the skipped hour is moved forward past the gap. Invalid timezones return 400 with a validation error.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees. Optional and does not affect the timeline. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees. Optional and does not affect the timeline. Defaults to 0.

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: First day of the forecast window in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today in UTC.

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: Last day of the forecast window in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to startDate plus 30 days. The window is clamped to a maximum of 90 days from startDate.

fields.name: domains
fields.description: Which forecast domains to include. Defaults to all three. Pass a subset to scope the timeline to one or two engines.

fields.name: minSignificance
fields.description: Drop events scoring below this significance threshold from 0 to 100. Defaults to 0, keeping all events.

fields.name: western
fields.description: Multiplier for this domain significance. 1 leaves it unchanged, above 1 promotes the domain, below 1 demotes it.

fields.name: vedic
fields.description: Multiplier for this domain significance. 1 leaves it unchanged, above 1 promotes the domain, below 1 demotes it.

fields.name: biorhythm
fields.description: Multiplier for this domain significance. 1 leaves it unchanged, above 1 promotes the domain, below 1 demotes it.
